key.bngbridge.camera_mode: Camera: Minecraft drives BeamNG / follows BeamNG
key.bngbridge.switch: Switch control to BeamNG (F4 in BeamNG comes back)
bngbridge.settings.ground.tip:
How BeamNG feels the ground in a real-terrain world.

Smooth: one-block steps become gentle slopes, so you can drive anywhere.

Real blocks: every block is a hard step, like Minecraft. A one-block step stops the car, and hitting one fast is a crash. Cliffs, holes and walls are the same in both.

Changing it rebuilds BeamNG's ground (a second or two).
bngbridge.settings.slope.tip: Smooth ground only: how many blocks a one-block step is spread over. Longer is gentler and easier to drive; shorter is bumpier and closer to the real blocks.
bngbridge.settings.sea.tip: Real BeamNG water at Minecraft's sea level: drive in and the engine floods and stalls. Off, the car drives along the sea floor. Changing it rebuilds BeamNG's ground.
bngbridge.settings.dent.tip: How hard your hits dent the car: swords, axes, arrows, anvils. 0% leaves no mark (and no flat tires); 300% dents three times as hard.
bngbridge.settings.shove.tip: How far a hit pushes the car. 0% and the car doesn't move when you hit it.
bngbridge.settings.crash_hurts.tip: A hard crash takes hearts from the driver, more the faster you stop. Off, you can crash as much as you like.
bngbridge.settings.cars_hurt.tip: A moving car hurts and throws the mobs and players it hits. Off, it doesn't hurt or throw them.
bngbridge.settings.chase_distance.tip: How far behind the car the third-person camera sits.
bngbridge.settings.chase_height.tip: How far above the car the third-person camera looks from.
bngbridge.settings.chase_follows.tip: When you leave the mouse alone while driving, the chase camera swings back behind the car. Off, it stays where you point it.
bngbridge.settings.dashboard.tip: Gear, speed and RPM at the bottom right while you drive, plus "in water" and "engine flooded".
bngbridge.settings.status.tip: The crossover's debug text in the top left: link, terrain, cars, fps. F9 turns it on and off too.
bngbridge.settings.open_buildings.tip: On: a roof, an upper floor or a lintel with room under it isn't ground, so you can drive into garages and under porches. Walls are still walls. Off: every building is a solid lump you crash into or drive over. Changing it rebuilds BeamNG's ground.
